_comment: Per-skill dependency manifest read by scripts/preflight.sh (the engine is vendored identically across the family; this file is where propose differs). Base checks — git work tree, gh installed+authenticated, jq — are always run by the engine.

require.name: python3
require.missing: python3 is required to pin file citations to blob URLs

optional_any.name: confluence-converter
optional_any.present: mark present — Confluence markdown→storage conversion available via the bundled md2storage.sh adapter
optional_any.missing: no mark — Confluence publishing needs a markdown→storage converter (install mark, or set CONFLUENCE_CONVERTER to one); GitHub publishing is unaffected

notes: The Confluence comment/ownership/page-fetch path uses the Atlassian MCP (getAccessibleAtlassianResources, getConfluencePage, updateConfluencePage, createConfluenceFooterComment); only the harness can check MCP availability, so the skill confirms it live (getAccessibleAtlassianResources) before relying on it and falls back to GitHub-only when absent. allowed-tools declares mcp__plugin_atlassian_atlassian__* by the family's plugin-MCP convention — confirm this matches the Atlassian server id your install actually binds (see the MCP-naming note in AGENTS.md). The bulk of Confluence publishing goes through confluence.sh (curl-over-REST, no MCP).
